change.kind: test harness only; no production/runtime source changed
change.root_cause: The 1366px browser case asserted a Node-side intercepted-request counter immediately after iframe DOM attachment. iframe attachment precedes completion of the asynchronous network route callback, so the counter could still be zero even though activation was correct.
change.fix: Register Playwright waitForResponse for the exact no-cookie YouTube player URL before keyboard activation; await the intercepted 200 response after the iframe appears, then keep asserting that the remote request count stays zero before activation and becomes positive after explicit activation.
